deadline.value: PhD applicants must apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; the page allows applications until December 15 but reviews them soon after the deadline.
deadline.quote: The deadline for PhD applicants is Tuesday, December 1, 2026 (for Fall 2027)

gre_general.value: PhD applicants must submit GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: PhD applicants: GRE scores are required.

gre_subject.value: The page does not name a subject test.

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to name up to two faculty members they would like to work with, which the page calls highly recommended.
supervisor.quote: applicants will be asked to provide up to two names of specific faculty members whom they would like to study under. This is highly recommended

funding.value: The page says the department will only admit PhD candidates if it has assistantship or fellowship support, a funding-before-admission rule, so no funding code is given.

entry_route.value: A typical PhD applicant holds a bachelor's degree in a related discipline, so entry straight from a bachelor's is the usual route.
entry_route.quote: A typical applicant is expected to have a bachelor of science in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related discipline from a recognized institution.

notes: The page's GRE line for 2026-2027 says GREs are required for PhD applications. The joint PhD in Computer Science and Learning Sciences (SESP) is not saved as a separate record.
